snippet.title: Bus Simulator 27 – Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
🚍 Bus Simulator 27 is coming to PC, PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S! 

🏝️ Wishlist now and learn more about the next installment in the series here:
➤ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397320?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=pre-announce&utm_medium=wishlist
➤ Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/bus-simulator-27-b34229
➤ PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10008396
➤ Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/bus-simulator-27/9PNHKN79L7NF

We’re happy to announce the development of Bus Simulator 27, the next official installment in the series. Developed by Polish studio Simteract, renowned for their experience with premium simulation games, this entry will take you to a delightful summer on the Iberian Peninsula – introducing never-seen-before gameplay possibilities, frequently requested features, and the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise

➡️ Subscribe to our channel to stay up-to-date: https://www.youtube.com/astragon?sub_confirmation=1 

#BusSimulator #SimulationGame #BusSimulation

Follow us for more details:
➤ Official website: https://bussimulator.com
➤ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/bussimgame
➤ Twitter: https://x.com/bussimgame
➤ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bussimgame
➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/astragon

🚍 What you can expect from Bus Simulator 27 🚍

Greetings from Felicia Bay!

Bus Simulator 27 will offer the most comprehensive bus fleet ever: With new, officially licensed brands and models, as well as iconic buses from previous entries, passengers waiting for a ride near the sunny beaches of Southern Europe can expect a truly unprecedented comfort!

Thanks to the power of Unreal Engine 5, you can also look forward to a major technical leap that will set a new standard for the series going forward. Whether you're behind the wheel, walking the streets or riding as a passenger, the city with all its distinct districts, busy streets, and impressive landmarks is yours to discover – either as a solo entrepreneur or with friends in 4-player co-operative mode.

Bus Simulator 27 will be released for PC, PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S with more details to be announced in the future!

Stay tuned for more information about all officially licensed buses, manufacturers, and exciting new features to be revealed later this year.
